pages.text: The Magic Workshop synthesizes $(bold)magic scrolls$() from elements. A wizard only casts what is loaded into the Cast Strategy bar — craft a scroll and equip it on a wizard to give it that combat spell.

$(li)Place a $(bold)Magic Workshop$() from the build panel; wizards run the synthesis jobs in queue order.$(li)$(bold)Aim your crosshair at it and right-click$() to open the panel: the left side lists the craftable spells (searchable by name), the right side shows the task queue.$(li)Pick a spell → set the quantity → $(bold)Submit$(). Finished scrolls go into the colony $(bold)warehouse$().$(li)Take the scroll from the warehouse into your own inventory, then drag it into the matching category slot on the wizard's strategy bar.
